title: Deeper/broader open-source implementation and ACIS semantic-route refresh
mode: Primary-source web research and local plan refinement; plan-only
scope: Expand the optional DWG/DXF peer matrix with a newly surfaced current Rust implementation and exact release/source identities.
Identify bounded independent ACIS/SAB geometry-evaluation routes without treating carrier parsing or self-roundtrip as semantic evidence.
Refine fast-first, generated-control test selection and evidence attribution without expanding validation cadence.

sources.revision: v0.6.5 release commit 289a616; v0.6.4 commit 8d5c46d; issue pages accessed 2026-10-22
sources.observed: The project advertises versioned DWG/DXF read/write, broad entities/objects, and ACIS support. v0.6.5 release notes describe R12 DXF writing, ACIS modeler-data work, audit/recovery, and bounded decode-failure recovery. v0.6.4 reports its own test and BricsCAD validation counts. Issue #132 described 0.6.3 data loss and was closed after v0.6.5 reported retention for named colors/table XDATA and explicit refusal for custom DWG records; issue #134 described a 0.6.4 AC1032 regression and was closed after a recovery change.
sources.limits: All are peer self-reports or issue reproductions scoped to named revisions. Same-codec roundtrip is not independent evidence. No peer package/repository was downloaded, built, or run.

sources.revision: Mutable app manifest and docs accessed 2026-10-22; codec fork rev cc17ec1; kernel rev 95556b2
sources.observed: The app pins an acadrust package from the opencadcodec fork and a separately versioned geometry kernel. Its documented save_verified workflow writes a target version, reopens, compares a semantic entity manifest, audits DXF handles, and returns a hash; it also documents an optional Windows reference-CAD AUDIT path. OpenCADKernel describes an early analytic-first B-rep layer and an ACIS lift/lower feature.
sources.limits: The app self-readback shares its codec lineage and is not a second parser vote. The kernel depends on the same codec-produced SatDocument; geometry evaluation may be a separate stage but is not broad ACIS/DWG evidence. No app, kernel, or reference CAD executable was run.

sources.observed: The project advertises its own SAT/SAB parser and conversion of supported B-rep geometry through CadQuery/OpenCascade. It labels itself experimental, documents version/producer-dependent geometry support and unsupported-record retention, and lists selected SAT/SAB/ASM profiles and analytic geometry with experimental NURBS/tolerant-boundary support.
sources.limits: Candidate only for bounded, independent shape semantics after exact-profile validation. No parser, kernel, or peer test corpus was run or imported. Corpus licensing is separate and must be reviewed before any use.

sources.revision: v3.8.0 signed commit 3a1c66b; mutable release/issue pages accessed 2026-10-22
sources.observed: The current latest formal release is v3.8.0. Release history includes ACIS carrier, AcDs payload-offset, and Prototype1b parser work. Issue #1195 reports modeler-entity omission against ACadSharp 3.4.9, not a reproduced result for v3.8.0.
sources.limits: No package was installed or run; the older issue cannot be projected onto the current release without route-matched reproduction.

sources.revision: Public project description and 2.5 programmer-guide pages accessed 2026-10-22
sources.observed: dxflib is a callback-style DXF reader/writer without its own document store; writing requires caller-managed records and strict call ordering. The accessible programming guide describes legacy R12/R2000-era support.
sources.limits: The guide is old and must not be used to infer current release coverage. This is not a DWG, full-document, or 3D modeler oracle.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8 optional exact-version DWG/DXF peer selection and stage attribution
PAR-14 pin source/release/artifact identity and distinguish peer self-roundtrip from independent reopen
Add cq-acis as a candidate bounded geometry-semantic route, not as a completed gate
Keep OpenCADStudio app, opencadcodec fork, OpenCADKernel, and any reference CAD console as distinct evidence lineages
Keep dxflib in the narrow 2D DXF callback-consumer category
Add candidate generated-control dimensions for custom classes, XDATA/named colors, AC1032 frame recovery, malformed lengths, and solids-only blocks, conditional on local source audit

planChanges: Added acadrust v0.6.5 as an optional pinned direct DWG/DXF comparator and captured its own release/validation evidence ceiling.
Recorded version-scoped acadrust issue #132/#134 histories as candidate regression dimensions, not local defects; required local reproduction before findings or tests.
Separated OpenCADStudio's app harness, opencadcodec fork, OpenCADKernel, and reference-CAD acceptance route; the same codec cannot count as an independent parser vote.
Added cq-acis as an experimental candidate for bounded ACIS/SAB shape semantics against independently known expected geometry, with exact profile and corpus-license checks.
Refreshed ACadSharp pin to v3.8.0 while keeping the 3.4.9 issue report version-scoped; classified dxflib as a narrow 2D-DXF callback route.
Refined the optional compact generated-control matrix without changing implementation order, validation cadence, fixtures, or the six external J gates.
limitations: GitHub releases, mutable branches, issues, and project documentation are time-sensitive; recorded source revisions and observations are scoped to 2026-10-22.
No peer artifact, sample, package, or executable was downloaded, built, installed, or run.
Peer project claims and issue reports are route-selection evidence only, not local reproductions or proof of current peer-release behavior outside the pinned report.
No external sample corpus was used; any cq-acis corpus use requires separate licensing/admission review.
This pass does not resolve native FreeCAD Linux/Windows qualification, independent ACIS/ACDS semantic evidence, or J256/J260/J268/J284/J293/J295.
